errors.text_span: с етикети на всеки две години
errors.evidence: The description states that the x-axis has labels every two years, but the plot shows labels for every single year from 10 to 20.
The blue line for Bulgaria ends at approximately 34.5% in 2020, not 33%.

Multiple data points for the blue line (Bulgaria) are reported incorrectly. For example, in 2016 the value is ~31%, not 35%; in 2017 the value is ~34.5%, not 32%; and in 2015 the value is ~29%, not 26%.
The red line for EU-27 ends at approximately 47.5% in 2020, not 48%.
The values for EU-27 in 2012 and 2013 are reported as 42% and 43%, but the plot shows they are closer to 40.5% and 41% respectively.
